hero.sub: Developer and community support specialist at 4Geeks Academy. I publish open source and tools in Spanish for Latin American devs.

porque.title: Why hire me?
porque.sub: Four reasons, each one with something you can verify.

items.title: I explain technical topics clearly
items.text: I am a senior mentor at 4Geeks Academy and support students every day. I publish documentation and catalogs in Spanish for the community.

items.title: I deliver with tests
items.text: My open source projects are really tested: 81 tests and 94 % coverage in mcp-readiness-check, and over 250 in apis-gratis-es.

items.title: Other teams accept my code
items.text: I have merged contributions in other people's projects: 6 PRs in pythiaLabs, plus DevSwitch and icon-sprite.

items.title: I understand the customer and the problem
items.text: I come from years in sales and customer service and from studying Medicine: I listen, diagnose the real problem and solve it with judgment.

privacidad.metaDescription: What data this site collects, what it is used for and how to exercise your rights.
privacidad.title: Privacy policy

sections.p: Only what you type in the contact form: name, email and message. The site uses no cookies, has no analytics or advertising, and does not track visitors.
Only to reply to your message. I do not sell it or share it with third parties for other purposes.

Submission goes through Web3Forms, which delivers the message to my inbox. Before sending, your browser asks Cloudflare (DNS over HTTPS) whether your email domain receives mail; only the domain (for example, gmail.com) is queried, never your full address.
As long as needed to handle your request and, at most, for as long as a possible professional relationship lasts. You can ask me to delete it at any time.
You can request access, correction or deletion of your data by writing to the email above.
